summary: ONE_CARRY_PRE_OUTCOME_FACTOR_DEFINITION_READY. CRYPTO_CARRY_CONDITIONED_DRA_ENTRY_RISK_VETO can be frozen as one source-agnostic, parameter-free semantic boundary: an immutable point-in-time description of crypto derivative demand and constrained arbitrage capital, fully received before an otherwise valid unlevered BTC spot DRA entry decision, whose only possible downstream use is admitting that unchanged entry or HOLD_CASH. The definition does not select a source, venue, contract, maturity, field, formula, normalization, sign, threshold, lookback, cadence or horizon. Fixed-maturity basis, perpetual funding transfers, liquidation or margin stress, executable carry-trade return and BTC spot-return prediction remain separately typed and non-interchangeable. The label is distinct from archived 508 funding_low only because it cannot be implemented as that Boolean, its sign reversal or a renamed funding gate; it must preserve both causal axes and strict pre-decision provenance. ShortBuildIndicator and BtFundingArb remain separate bearish-context and two-leg execution mechanisms. DRA source, spot-only long execution, arm, cooldown, one-lot limit, entry confirmation, profit-only exit, route and capacity remain unchanged. This result is NON_COUNTING and authorizes only one later bounded source-readiness and representation-proof audit. R2 remains untouched. Immediate PnL and drawdown effects are ZERO; all predictive and economic effects remain MISSING_PROOF.
